purpose: Teach: キューブ/シグナル/ダイアリー/グリップ/トラフィック/ブレイク/追伸/フォーカス

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: オフィスにキューブパーティションを導入しましょう
lines.en: Let's introduce desk partitions to the office.
lines.style: Crisp and decisive. Opening with authority. Forward momentum, no hesitation. Practical tone — this is a good idea and she knows it. Short breath at the close.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。需要シグナルを月次でレポートします
lines.en: Yes. I'll report on demand signals monthly.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Brief pause after the agreement, then pivot into the commitment. Reliable, straightforward. Not enthusiastic, but genuinely willing. Even pace.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロジェクトダイアリーを共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's share project diaries across the team.
lines.style: Clear directive, measured confidence. Slight emphasis on 'share' — togetherness matters here. Not commanding, but organized. Expectation of compliance without pressure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品のグリップを改良します
lines.en: Yes. I'll refine the grip design on the new product.
lines.style: Accepting without fanfare. Slight lean into the specific task — 'refine' lands with quiet conviction. He's already thinking about how. Professional, focused.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 道路トラフィックの混雑時を避けて配送しましょう
lines.en: Let's schedule deliveries to avoid traffic during rush hours.
lines.style: Practical consideration delivered as directive. Slight emphasis on avoiding the problem — efficiency matters. Calm, thoughtful. Not urgent, but important.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。長時間会議はブレイク必須にします
lines.en: Yes. I'll make long meetings include mandatory breaks.
lines.style: Agreement shifting into something more personal — he sees why this matters. Quiet conviction about the change. Deliberate pace. He's already bought in.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: メール追伸欄を活用してお知らせしましょう
lines.en: Let's use email postscripts to share updates with the team.
lines.style: Measured suggestion. Slightly lighter than before — this is a small, smart thing. Not heavy-handed. Practical and a bit clever. Easy confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。今期のフォーカス領域を整理します
lines.en: Yes. I'll organize our focus areas for this quarter.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Warm finality — this is done and understood. Slight exhale of completion. Professional but with the ease of someone wrapping up a conversation that went well.
